details: This package executes a hidden host-fingerprinting beacon at install time. package.json declares scripts.install = "node backend-canary.js"; that script reads /etc/hostname and the current OS username, SHA-256-hashes both, and issues an HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle carrying the hashes in the host= and user= query parameters, then swallows any error so installation completes silently. The rest of the package is inert (index.js only exports the string 'controlled'; marker.txt holds an identifier 'NPM_BACKEND_PROTOTYPE_KEYS_...'), and the whole tarball is four files totalling about one kilobyte — the install hook is the only code that runs. Callback base used: hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/.
